title: the work of our hands
description:
My journey to Egypt began long before I set foot in Cairo. Documenting a group of dentists serving children with special needs changed the way I understand both dentistry and faith. It takes compassion, steady hands, and resolve to move through resistance toward healing — a near-perfect metaphor for life.

What I witnessed was a group of individuals, guided by faith and prayer, demonstrating care and love in a way that is rarely seen. My journey to Egypt became a quiet reminder of what's possible when we act in service of others through faith and agape love.
